items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: there would be a studio orchestra in the studio while Chico O’Farrill conducted it

ctx.x: Wait a minute, you moved from New York to Vermont or the other way around?

I mean from New York to Vermont. I’m in Vermont right now, I’ve been here 15 years. So I was like 46, 47 years old. Before I came up here I had to earn a living in New York City doing a wide variety of things: recording sessions, jingle dates of you don’t know what the hell it’s going to be but they don’t send you the music in advance and they don’t give you — now people have jingle dates they’ve got to call you three days — three or four days — a month in advance. “Oh I’ve got a jingle date then.” In the old…
You’re not going to be talking either.
